parameter.name: port
parameter.description: TCP port for SeedLink connections. By default the SeedLink standard port 18000 will be used.

parameter.name: sslport
parameter.description: TCP port for encrypted (SSL) SeedLink connections. Disabled (0) by default.

parameter.name: privateKey
parameter.description: Location of SSL private key file.

parameter.name: segments
parameter.description: Number of segments per station. By default, 10 segments will be used.

parameter.name: segsize
parameter.description: Segment size in records. By default, 1000 records will be used.

parameter.name: recsize
parameter.description: Maximum record size in bytes, including metadata header. The default is 1024 bytes. Total size of the ringbuffer per station is segments*segsize*recsize. These parameters can be overridden on a station-by-station basis using seedlink bindings.

parameter.name: granularity
parameter.description: Time index granularity. Default is 600 seconds.

parameter.name: organization
parameter.description: Data center description in HELLO response.

parameter.name: trusted
parameter.description: List of IP adresses and/or usernames of clients who have FEED and INFO CONNECTIONS permission and full access to all stations regardless of the "access" setting.

parameter.name: access
parameter.description: List of IP adresses and/or usernames that can access stations by default. This can be overridden on a station-by-station basis using seedlink bindings. Empty means no access restrictions.
